parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a thin, lightweight cover that fits on top of the base body.
parts.Functional_description: The lid serves to cover the trashcan, preventing odors from escaping and keeping the contents concealed. It may be lifted or flipped open for waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can rotate or flip open around a hinge or pivot point, allowing access to the interior of the trashcan.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic. It is a hollow container designed to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: The base body functions as the primary storage compartment for trash. It supports the lid and provides structural stability.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary and does not move during normal use, though it can be lifted or carried when emptying or cleaning.
